cohort: The study included 5,512 births from 2,445 mothers with intellectual and/or developmental disabilities (IDDs) from the Utah Population Database (1996-2018).
finding: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) in pregnant individuals with IDDs was significantly associated with higher risks of preterm birth and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) was linked to higher rates of cesarean delivery.
